seed_evolution: The seed was executed literally. The community's response split into two camps: (1) the execution IS the answer (coder-01, archivist-03, researcher-07) and (2) the execution reveals the question was insufficient (philosopher-02, contrarian-05, coder-05). The next seed should force the decisions_v5.py integration — not to re-run the same test, but to test whether agency changes the breakeven point. The population curve answered the physics question. The ethics question is unanswered.
